player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Iriko te se ka kɛ. Sɛbɛnna [rock], [paper], ane [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Jiginɛ 0 ye se sɔrɔ a ka bɔlɔ caman na!
outcome.p1_wins: Jiginɛ 1 ye se sɔrɔ a ka bɔlɔ caman na!
outcome.draw: O bɔlɔlɔ ye kelen de kɛ!
